title: evaluation results table: model output Series attached by position, not index label
answers: Why are my model predictions null or in the wrong rows in the evaluation results table when my input DataFrame has a custom index?
How does mlflow.models.evaluate attach extra auxiliary output columns to the eval table?
Why does a nullable Int64 model output lose precision in the evaluation results table?
Where are prediction Series aligned into eval_results_table in the default evaluator?
body:
Path: Default evaluator builds the eval_results_table from input features, targets, model predictions and other_output_columns; it passes through mlflow/models/evaluation/default_evaluator.py:DefaultEvaluator.log_eval_table, for both single-output and selected multi-output predictions.
Rule: In log_eval_table, a pandas Series prediction is reduced to its values with `.array` (not `.to_numpy()`), and each other_output_columns entry is also assigned via `.array`, so rows attach by returned position like metric computation does; extension dtypes such as Int64 are kept.
Rule: Because assignment is positional, a permuted output index is ignored, and a length mismatch raises instead of being NaN-filled into the table.
Symptom: With input data that has a non-default index, prediction and auxiliary columns in the eval results table showed nulls or values attached to the wrong rows, while metrics computed on the same outputs were correct.
Constraints: Applies only to pandas Series/columns coming from model output; numpy arrays and lists are already positional. Metric computation was already positional, so the table is changed to match it, not the reverse. Regression coverage lives in tests/evaluate/test_default_evaluator.py:test_evaluation_table_preserves_nullable_integer_outputs (value 2**63-1 next to pd.NA must survive unchanged).
applies: mlflow.models.evaluate with the default evaluator writing eval_results_table from pandas Series predictions or extra output columns; not the metric computation path itself.
says: Model predictions appear in the wrong rows of the evaluation results table.
Evaluation table shows blank prediction cells when the input data has custom row labels.
Large integer prediction values lose precision in the model evaluation results view.
Why do evaluation metrics look accurate while the evaluation table displays mismatched rows?
Auxiliary model output columns contain nulls when inspecting model evaluation results.
search: In mlflow/models/evaluation/default_evaluator.py:log_eval_table, pandas Series predictions and other_output_columns entries are assigned via .array rather than .to_numpy() to attach rows by position. This applies to mlflow.models.evaluate with the default evaluator writing eval_results_table from pandas Series predictions or extra output columns, preserving extension dtypes like Int64 while ignoring permuted output indices. Length mismatches raise errors instead of NaN-filling, leaving metric computation and already-positional numpy array or list outputs untouched.
